head: Apple Support Community forums close on 20 November
dek: Apple's Support Community forums, where users help each other fix problems, stopped taking new posts and will close for good on 20 November. Apple didn't give a reason.
details: The forums are read-only until then. They go back to at least 1998, when they were called Apple Tech Exchange, and were relaunched as Apple Support Communities in 2011.
means: Old answers you found through search may disappear after 20 November.
todo: Save any forum answers you rely on before 20 November; for new problems, use Apple Support's own pages and contact options.
